newsitem.title: USA: Seagram Co U.S. unit appoints controller.
newsitem.headline: Seagram Co U.S. unit appoints controller.

text.p: Seagram Co Ltd's U.S. corporate subsidiary, Joseph E. Seagram & Sons Inc, said Wednesday it appointed Frank Mergenthaler to vice president, controller, effective July 1.
Mergenthaler will be responsible for ensuring effective financial controls and the management and public reporting functions for the beverage and entertainment businesses.
Mergenthaler joined Seagram in 1996 as assistant treasurer, international, with responsibility for all treasury matters affecting Seagram's affiliates outside of North America.
Seagram Co operates in two global business segments: beverages and entertainment. The beverage businesses spirits, wines, fruit juices, coolers, beers and mixers.
The entertainment company, Universal Studios Inc, produces and distributes motion picture, television and home video products, recorded music and operates theme parks and retail stores.
